spec_family.name: Exterior Metal Repaint
spec_family.description: Condition-driven repaint of existing exterior metal components — railings (LF), gutters/downspouts (LF), ornamental iron (EA), and miscellaneous metal items (EA). Adapts NC spec (SF_METAL_EXT_v1) to repaint context with mandatory condition assessment, rust-grade-driven prep intensity, and 5 substrate states. Rust is the PRIMARY repaint driver. Three rust grades (flash/moderate/heavy) map to escalating prep paths: SP2 hand tool, SP3 power tool, and needle gun + SP3. Structural rust is a HARD STOP. Four substrate types (carbon_steel, wrought_iron, aluminum, galvanized) drive primer chemistry — unchanged from NC. Profile complexity remains the primary labor modifier (ornate = 2.25x). Condition modifier (FAC_MTRP_CONDITION) is the RP-specific addition — applied to prep tasks only. QT2-QT4 range (QT2 for utility items, QT5 excluded for RP — premium restoration should be quoted as NC strip-to-bare). Gloss excluded for RP. spray_backbrush dropped — brush and spray only. Environmental modifiers excluded per PaintFactor OS RC-003. RRP gate present but low-probability trigger for metal. No roll application.

includes: On-site condition assessment (rust grade, coating adhesion, substrate type identification, profile complexity)
Structural rust gate check — HARD STOP if section loss or perforation detected
Lead paint testing for pre-1978 structures (EPA RRP Rule 40 CFR 745)
Power wash all metal surfaces (1000-1500 PSI) to remove loose rust, chalk, dirt
SP1 solvent cleaning (mandatory first step ALL metal substrates)
SP2 hand tool cleaning — wire brush, scraper, sandpaper (flash rust, sound existing paint)
SP3 power tool cleaning — grinder, wire wheel, flap disc (moderate/heavy rust, failing paint)
Needle gun / power scraper for heavy rust scale deposits
Aluminum scuff abrasion (Scotch-Brite/maroon pad for adhesion profile)
Galvanized solvent wipe and vinegar/ammonia wash prep
Rust converter application on residual rust after mechanical prep (24 hr cure)
Degloss existing sound coating (scuff sand or liquid degloss)
Strip failing existing coating (scraping, chemical stripper, aggressive mechanical)
Metal-to-building junction caulking (polyurethane sealant — NOT silicone)
Substrate-driven primer application (DTM acrylic/alkyd for ferrous, etch for bare non-ferrous, bonding for sound existing non-ferrous)
Spot prime bare areas on sound existing (ferrous DTM or non-ferrous bonding)
Two finish coats DTM acrylic (satin or semi-gloss)
Intercoat inspection (all tiers) and scuff sand (QT4)
Final inspection and touch-up
Landscape/hardscape/siding/fixture/roof edge protection
Scaffold/lift setup and teardown (conditional on access_type)

excludes.item: Structural rust repair (welding, section replacement, metalwork fabrication)
excludes.route_to: Structural metalwork contractor — HARD STOP if detected
PROHIBITED — rollers ineffective on metal profiles
EXCLUDED — requires substrate perfection not achievable over existing paint
EXCLUDED — premium restoration requires NC strip-to-bare (zinc-rich primer, DFT verification, near-white blast)

excludes.item: RRP containment and lead-safe work practices
excludes.route_to: EPA RRP certified contractor scope — triggered by positive lead test on pre-1978 structures

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling prep rigor, inspection scrutiny, intercoat sanding, and defect tolerance.
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT2=economy (utility metal — downspouts, vent covers, reduced inspection). QT3=standard (residential railings, gutters). QT4=premium (decorative ironwork, intercoat sand, close-range inspection). QT5 excluded — premium restoration requires NC strip-to-bare approach.

configuration_dimensions.description: Metal substrate material — drives primer chemistry selection and compatibility rules.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Retained from NC unchanged. Per-item capture for mixed-substrate projects. Magnet test distinguishes ferrous from non-ferrous.

configuration_dimensions.description: Existing coating / rust condition — drives prep intensity, primer scope, condition modifier, and round configuration. Assessed on-site.
configuration_dimensions.notes: 5 RP-specific states. Sound paint = lightest prep. Flash rust = SP2. Moderate rust = SP3. Heavy rust = needle gun + SP3. Failing paint = strip + SP3. Structural rust is NOT a valid input state — HARD STOP.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for prime and finish coats.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Brush is primary for metal RP detail work. Spray for production gutter runs. spray_backbrush dropped for RP — brush provides better control on inconsistent RP substrates. Roll PROHIBITED.
Gloss excluded for RP — substrate imperfections magnified at gloss level.

paintable_items.name: Exterior metal railing
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of railing measured along top rail. Includes pickets, balusters, post caps, and all components within the railing assembly.
paintable_items.notes: Reused from NC spec. Porch railings, balcony railings, stair railings. Profile complexity modifier applied per railing type.

paintable_items.name: Exterior gutter and downspout
paintable_items.counting_rules: Linear feet of gutter run plus linear feet of downspout run, measured separately. One gutter section at each roof edge.
paintable_items.notes: Reused from NC spec. Gutters typically galvanized or aluminum. Downspouts are separate LF measurement.

paintable_items.name: Ornamental iron / decorative metalwork
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each discrete ornamental piece. Finials, scrollwork panels, gate hardware, decorative brackets, lamp posts.
paintable_items.notes: Reused from NC spec. Profile complexity modifier is critical for ornamental items (ornate = 2.25x).

paintable_items.name: Miscellaneous metal items
paintable_items.counting_rules: Each discrete utility metal item. Vent covers, HVAC line covers, window wells, mailbox posts, meter covers.
paintable_items.notes: Reused from NC spec. Typically QT2 utility items. Simple profiles.

variants.notes: BASELINE RP. Sound existing paint on steel railing, brush. Degloss + spot prime + 2 finish. Lightest RP prep.
Flash rust on steel. SP2 hand tool + optional rust converter + full DTM prime + 2 finish.
Moderate rust on steel. SP3 power tool + rust converter (24 hr cure) + DTM prime + 2 finish.
Heavy rust on wrought iron. Needle gun + SP3 + rust converter + DTM prime + 2 finish. Most labor-intensive.
Failing paint on steel. Strip + SP3 + full DTM prime + 2 finish.
Economy galvanized gutter repaint. Spray production. Bonding primer spot on bare areas. Full protection for spray.
Aluminum gutter/downspout with surface oxidation. Etch primer on exposed areas + 2 finish. Spray for production.
Economy repaint of misc utility metal items (vent covers, HVAC covers). Minimal protection. QT2.
FLAG: EXCEEDS 4.0x CAP on prep (moderate 1.60 x scaffold 1.60 x ornate 2.25 x QT4 1.15 = 6.62x). Coating stack: scaffold 1.60 x ornate 2.25 x QT4 1.15 = 4.14x. Estimator review required.

valid_input_states.notes: 5 RP substrate states. Sound paint = intact coating, good adhesion. Flash rust = surface oxidation, no pitting. Moderate rust = visible pitting, scale beginning. Heavy rust = deep pitting, thick scale (not structural). Failing paint = peeling, flaking, blistering. Structural rust is NOT a valid input — HARD STOP requiring structural repair.

output_state.notes: All valid input states resolve to SS_EXT_PAINTED_METAL after this spec completes. Prep and primer normalize the substrate.

ferrous.notes: Spot prime bare areas only. Existing coating provides base.

non_ferrous.notes: Bonding primer on deglosed non-ferrous bare areas.

ferrous.notes: Full DTM prime after SP2 + optional rust converter.

non_ferrous.notes: Etch primer on exposed non-ferrous after cleaning.

ferrous.notes: Full DTM prime after SP3 + rust converter. Alkyd option for pitted surfaces.
Full DTM prime after needle gun + SP3 + rust converter. Alkyd for heavy pitting.
Full DTM prime after strip + SP3.

non_ferrous.notes: Etch primer on exposed non-ferrous after strip.

protection_zones_required.notes: Metal prep generates heavier debris than standard painting. 4-6 mil plastic minimum. Always required.
Adjacent walkways/patios. Canvas for crew traffic. Upgrade for spray.
Siding behind metal components. Light tape for brush. Full plastic for spray.
Bag and tape light fixtures near metal work areas.
Roof edge at gutter line. Only when gutter work is in scope.

material_systems.name: DTM Acrylic Primer for Ferrous Metal Repaint
material_systems.notes: Standard primer for ferrous metal RP. Spot or full depending on condition.

material_systems.name: DTM Alkyd Primer for Pitted Ferrous
material_systems.notes: Alkyd for pitted surfaces. BLOCKED on galvanized/aluminum.

material_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Sound Existing Non-Ferrous
material_systems.notes: Adhesion bridge on sound existing non-ferrous.

material_systems.name: DTM Acrylic Exterior Finish
material_systems.notes: Universal DTM acrylic topcoat. 2 coats standard. Gloss excluded.

material_systems.name: Rust Converter Treatment
material_systems.notes: Converts rust to stable iron phosphate. 24 hr cure. Ferrous metals only.

round_configurations.description: Sound existing paint — degloss + spot prime + 2 finish coats
round_configurations.notes: Lightest RP round. Degloss + spot prime bare areas + 2 finish. Single mobilization.

round_configurations.description: Flash rust — SP2 + optional rust converter + full prime + 2 finish
round_configurations.notes: Surface oxidation. SP2 hand tool prep + rust converter (optional, adds 24 hr cure if used) + full prime + 2 finish.

round_configurations.description: Moderate rust — SP3 + rust converter (24 hr cure) + full prime + 2 finish
round_configurations.notes: SP3 power tool + rust converter (24 hr cure = 2 mobilizations) + DTM prime + 2 finish. Rust converter adds a mobilization.

round_configurations.description: Heavy rust — needle gun + SP3 + rust converter (24 hr cure) + full prime + 2 finish
round_configurations.notes: Most labor-intensive round. Needle gun for heavy scale + SP3 for final profile + rust converter (24 hr cure) + DTM prime + 2 finish.

round_configurations.description: Failing paint — strip + SP3 + full prime + 2 finish
round_configurations.notes: Strip failing coating + SP3 to bright metal + full DTM prime + 2 finish. High prep labor similar to moderate rust minus rust converter.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Siding adjacent to metal. Protection is THIS spec's responsibility during spray.

Trim at metal mounting points. Junction caulking is THIS spec's task.
Concrete at railing base. Not painted — protection at base connection.
Roof at gutter line. Roof edge protection required during gutter painting.

site_condition_rules.notes: FAC_EXT_ACCESS modifier on all tasks + fixed scaffold/lift setup/teardown tasks.
FAC_MTRP_PROFILE_COMPLEXITY on prep and coating tasks. Per-component.
FAC_MTRP_CONDITION on prep tasks only. Driven by substrate_state assessment.
TSK_MTRP_ASSESS_LEAD. Positive result escalates to RRP scope.

hard_stops.description: Section loss >25%, perforation, or load-bearing joint failure. Requires structural repair by welder/fabricator before painting.

sibling_spec.relationship: NC sibling. Same 4 paintable items, same substrate types, same primer chemistry. RP adds condition assessment, rust-grade-driven prep, condition modifier, QT2-QT4 range (NC was QT3-QT5), gloss excluded, spray_backbrush dropped, environmental modifiers excluded.

adjacent_specs.relationship: Wood trim at metal mounting points. Trim painting belongs to trim spec.
Steel garage door RP is separate spec. Different context prefix (GDRP vs MTRP).

deduplication_notes: Siding/masonry protection during metal spray is THIS spec's responsibility.
Metal-to-building junction caulking is THIS spec's task.
Scaffold setup/teardown labor modeled as fixed tasks — rental cost is separate line item.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Setup (mobilize, scaffold) -> Protect -> Assess (condition, adhesion, structural rust gate, lead test) -> Prep (power wash -> SP1 -> mechanical prep per condition -> substrate-specific prep -> rust convert -> dust clean -> caulk) -> Prime (substrate/condition-driven) -> Finish 1 -> Interstage (inspect, sand QT4, repair, dust) -> Finish 2 -> Final Inspect & Touch-up -> Cleanup
sequencing_notes.component_order: Gutters/downspouts FIRST (highest access, spray production). Railings SECOND. Ornamental THIRD (detail brush). Misc items LAST.
sequencing_notes.key_prohibitions: NO roll application. NO alkyd on galvanized. NO painting over structural rust. NO gloss sheen. NO QT5. SP1 solvent clean ALWAYS first prep step. Rust converter on ferrous metals only.

relationships.notes: RP sibling of NC metal spec. 41 tasks across 9 modules (NC had 37 across 8). Key RP additions: condition assessment module, 5 RP substrate states, condition modifier, needle gun task, power wash task. Key RP removals: zinc-rich primer (QT5), epoxy primer (specialty), spray_backbrush, environmental modifiers.

research_corrections.original_claim: spray_backbrush should be retained from NC
research_corrections.corrected_to: Brush-only provides better film control on inconsistent RP substrates. Spray retained for production runs. spray_backbrush dropped.

research_corrections.original_claim: Environmental conditions should be estimation modifiers
research_corrections.corrected_to: Excluded per PaintFactor OS RC-003 — unpredictable at bid time.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for exterior metal repaint. RP sibling of SF_METAL_EXT_v1. Key features: mandatory condition assessment (4 tasks), 5 RP substrate states (sound paint, flash/moderate/heavy rust, failing paint), condition modifier FAC_MTRP_CONDITION on prep tasks only (1.0-2.25x), rust-grade-driven prep (SP2/SP3/needle gun), rust converter treatment, 4 substrate types (carbon_steel/wrought_iron/aluminum/galvanized) with unchanged primer chemistry, 4 paintable items (railing LF, gutter LF, ornamental EA, misc EA), 6 material systems (4 primer + 1 finish + 1 rust converter), 41 tasks across 9 modules (40 binary + 1 qt_conditional), 4 factor modifiers (profile_complexity/access/QT/condition), 5 round configurations, 5 protection zones, 9 variants, 13 PaintScope inputs. QT2-QT4 range (QT2 for utility, QT5 excluded for RP). Satin/semi-gloss sheens (gloss excluded). Brush/spray only (spray_backbrush dropped, roll prohibited). Environmental modifiers excluded per RC-003. HARD STOP on structural rust. RRP gate for pre-1978 (low probability). Context prefix MTRP. Stacking: prep worst 9.32x (extreme, recommend T&M), coating worst 4.14x (slightly over cap), realistic worst 3.24x. QA: pass_with_warnings (4 issues, 0 blockers).
